title: Hadoota
overview: Hadoota, a 40-year-old thug, can’t remember the hiding place of an International artist he kidnapped. He resorts to hypnotherapy to retrieve this missing information. But in order to restore his memory, he needs to confront old enemies, past events, and most importantly… himself.

title: Never Crossed the Mind
overview: In the heart of Luxor, Younes embarks on a romantic and comedic adventure when he becomes in charge of a multinational tourist group. While he tries to communicate with them in four different languages, he falls in love with a girl in the middle of ancient temples, and encounters funny situations that prove that the language of the heart is the truest, no matter how different the tongues are.

title: Crypto
overview: The story revolves around an Italian mafia family that contacts the two sons of its late leader, who are living in Egypt, to inform them of their inheritance rights. However, two Egyptian men impersonate the heirs and travel to Italy, where they find themselves caught up in a series of unexpected situations and complications.

title: You Can See Everything
overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
